sources.title: Classifier Playground
sources.snippet: In this interactive playground, you can explore the capabilities of multiple AI and ML models for classifying data. To begin, create your own dataset using the options provided in the side menu. Once your dataset is ready, you can select a ML model to train and test on the data. sources.snippet: The AI Playground is an interactive interface for testing AI models with full control over parameters. You can choose any model, adjust temperature and max tokens, add system prompts, and see raw model output with token usage statistics.
